raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Draft for **stage-local eager DBO with pipeline parallelism in MRV2**, tracked in #64334.

**Work in progress, opened to reserve and discuss this scope. Only static review and CPU unit tests are complete. This is not ready to merge.** CUDA graph support will be a separate follow-up.

## Claims

- Allow PP+DBO in MRV2 only for explicit `--enable-dbo`, NIXL EP, DP>1 with expert parallelism, TP=1, synchronous scheduling and no CUDA graphs. Every other PP+DBO combination is still rejected.
- Reuse the existing intermediate-tensor slicing/merging, per-stage DP agreement, PP transport ownership and last-stage sampling.
- No claim of distributed model correctness, throughput improvement or TPOT reduction.

## Validation

CPU only; no GPU or end-to-end runs for this revision.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| New positive config case against unmodified base | Rejected with `does not yet support: dual batch overlap with pipeline parallelism`, as expected |
| `tests/test_config.py -k 'pp_dbo or pipeline_without_dbo_keeps_async_support or dbo'` | **12 passed** |
| `tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py` on CPU | **27 passed**, 10 skipped (existing GPU-only cases) |
| Ruff check/format, mypy on `vllm/config/vllm.py`, `git diff --check` | Passed |
| Real PP2 × DP2 model serving | **Not qualified** |
| End-to-end performance | **Not measured** |

Reproduction:

```bash
VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 pytest -q tests/test_config.py \
    -k 'pp_dbo or pipeline_without_dbo_keeps_async_support or dbo'
pytest -q tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py
```

`tests/v1/worker` is already selected by the `V1 Executor + Worker` CI step, and `tests/test_config.py` by `Engine Core`.

## Details

The production change is **+17/-4** in `VllmConfig._get_dbo_unsupported_features`. It replaces the unconditional PP rejection with one condition and reuses `ParallelConfig.use_batched_dp_moe` for the EP and DP>1 requirement. It checks `cudagraph_mode == NONE` rather than `enforce_eager`, because CUDA graphs are the actual limitation. The platform is left to the existing DBO all2all-backend check.

The existing `UBatchRunner` already slices each `IntermediateTensors` key and merges outputs before the worker sends a complete batch to the next stage. The new CPU test checks that round trip through `slice_model_inputs` and `merge_ubatch_outputs`. The draft does not introduce a new PP transport, scheduling algorithm or cross-stage microbatch protocol.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Complete batch at PP stage 0] --> B[Two local DBO microbatches]
    B --> C[Merge intermediate tensors]
    C -->|Existing full-batch PP transfer| D[PP stage 1 local DBO]
    D --> E[Merge and sample original rank-local batch]
```

Async scheduling resolves to enabled by default, so users must pass `--no-async-scheduling`; the docs state this.

Before readiness:
- [ ] Qualify a real PP2 × DP2 × TP1 model and confirm both microbatch IDs execute on all four workers.
- [ ] Validate imbalance, idle-rank recovery, request-slot reuse and complete-batch PP boundaries.
- [ ] Compare outputs/logprobs and document the supported model/backend scope.
- [ ] Measure the relevant end-to-end costs before making any performance claim.

This is main-based and does not stack the separate staging/FA3/metadata-fusion/abort PRs. Related work was checked: #50738 explicitly excludes PP; #63483 adds pure-TP DBO and retains the PP restriction; #53948 handles the PP receive queue; #63373 removes MRV1. No open implementation of this same scoped eager PP+DBO feature was found in the current search.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

@@ -34,13 +34,59 @@ To enable the DBO system pass in the `--enable-dbo` argument to your vllm serve
 * `--dbo-decode-token-threshold` the minimum number of tokens in a decode-only batch required to enable DBO for that batch
 * `--dbo-prefill-token-threshold` the minimum number of tokens in a batch containing at least one prefill required to enable DBO for that batch
 
-Currently, DBO is only supported with DeepEP, so DeepEP must be installed and the `--all2all-backend` argument must be set to `deepep_low_latency` if your workload is primarily decode requests, or `deepep_high_throughput` if your workload is primarily prefill requests.
+For DeepEP deployments, install DeepEP and set `--all2all-backend` to
+`deepep_low_latency` for workloads dominated by decode requests, or
+`deepep_high_throughput` for workloads dominated by prefill requests. The MRV2
+pipeline example below uses the NIXL EP backend instead.
 
 Below is a command that will spin up a two DP rank server with expert parallelism and DBO enabled.
 EX: `vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite --trust-remote-code --data-parallel-size 2 --enable-expert-parallel --enable-dbo --all2all-backend deepep_low_latency`
 
 Note that there must be at least two GPUs visible in `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`
 
+## Pipeline parallelism with Model Runner V2
+
+!!! warning "Draft implementation"
+    This support is under development. Configuration and local microbatch
+    tests do not establish four-GPU model correctness or performance.
+
+MRV2 supports stage-local DBO with NIXL EP, DP+EP, TP=1, synchronous
+scheduling, and eager execution. Set `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` and pass both
+`--enforce-eager` and `--no-async-scheduling`. CUDA graphs and asynchronous
+scheduling remain unsupported for this combination.
+
+Each pipeline stage agrees on the split within its own DP group. The stage
+receives a complete batch of intermediate tensors, slices all intermediate
+keys for its two DBO microbatches, and merges the outputs before sending the
+complete batch to the next stage. Sampling remains once per original batch
+on the last stage. The existing PP sampled-token queue and request-generation
+checks continue to manage the returned tokens.
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart LR
+    A[PP stage 0: complete batch] --> B[Two local DBO microbatches]
+    B --> C[Merge intermediate tensors]
+    C -->|One complete batch| D[PP stage 1: receive]
+    D --> E[Two local DBO microbatches]
+    E --> F[Merge hidden states]
+    F --> G[Sample original batch once]
+```
+
+The smallest DP2 x PP2 configuration uses four GPUs:
+
+```bash
+VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat \
+    --trust-remote-code --dtype bfloat16 \
+    --pipeline-parallel-size 2 --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
+    --data-parallel-size 2 --data-parallel-size-local 2 \
+    --enable-expert-parallel --enable-dbo --all2all-backend nixl_ep \
+    --moe-backend batched_triton --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN_MLA \
+    --enforce-eager --no-async-scheduling
+```
+
+This enables overlap within a stage; it does not change the PP scheduling
+algorithm or imply a throughput improvement for every batch shape.
+
 ## DBO Components
 
 * GPUModelRunner

+def _make_pp_dbo_config(*, enforce_eager=True, async_scheduling=False, **parallel):
+    return VllmConfig(
+        model_config=ModelConfig(
+            model="Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B",
+            max_model_len=512,
+            enforce_eager=enforce_eager,

+                    "pipeline_parallel_size": 2,
+                    "data_parallel_size": 2,
+                    "enable_dbo": True,
+                    "all2all_backend": "nixl_ep",
+                    "distributed_executor_backend": "mp",
+                    "nnodes": 2,
+                    "enable_expert_parallel": True,
+                    "tensor_parallel_size": 1,
+                }
+                | parallel
+            )
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def test_pp_dbo_supports_eager_synchronous_dp_ep(monkeypatch):
+    """Pipeline boundaries remain full batches while each stage uses DBO."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")
+    config = _make_pp_dbo_config()
+    assert config.use_v2_model_runner
+    assert config.parallel_config.num_ubatches == 2
+
+

+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")

+        _make_pp_dbo_config(**settings)
+
+

+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")

+    assert config.scheduler_config.async_scheduling is True
